end.summary:
• Practised sorting objects as rolling, sliding, or stacking.
• Predicted curved-surface objects roll: 6 of 8 unaided correct.
• Predicted flat-faced objects slide: 2 of 2 unaided correct.
• Initially said only balls roll; later identified bottles, oranges, drums, and ghee containers with curved sides as rolling.
• Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised noticing curved surfaces for rolling and flat faces for sliding or stacking. Anika used examples such as bottles, oranges, drums, matchboxes, and ghee containers; the “only balls can roll” mix-up was corrected later when they explained that a ghee container rolls on its curved side and rests on its flat base. At home, ask them to predict whether safe household objects will roll, slide, or stack, and explain which surface helped them decide.

Gol pahiya ghoomkar auto ko chalata hai. Chaukor pahiya har kone par jhatka dega; rukna zaroori nahi. Ghadi ka chaukor hona alag baat hai, uske pahiye nahi. Agar ghee ka dibba gol side par rakho, toh woh kya karega?
Ghee ka dibba... gol side pe rakho toh lurhkega! Gol hai na, toh ball ki tarah lurhak jaayega. Par tez nahi, dhakkan khol ke dekho toh...
Haan, gol side par dibba lurhkega. Dhakkan kholne ki zaroorat nahi; band hi rehne do. Ab usko flat tale par rakho, toh kya hoga?
Flat tale pe rakho toh... woh khada rahega, phislega bhi nahi, kyunki tala sapaat hai. Toh roll nahi karega. Bas khada rahega.
Haan, sapaat tale par dibba khada rahega; apne aap roll nahi karega. Dhakka doge toh phisal sakta hai. Uske upar ek aur band dibba rakho, toh kya woh tik paayega?
